- [Jigsaw Piece](https://mapgenie.io/croc-legend-of-gobbos/maps/ice-island?locationIds=CART_932) in [Clouds of Ice](https://mapgenie.io/croc-legend-of-gobbos/maps/ice-island?locationIds=CART_921)
- [Jigsaw Piece](https://mapgenie.io/croc-legend-of-gobbos/maps/ice-island?locationIds=CART_1004) in [Ice Bridge to Eternity](https://mapgenie.io/croc-legend-of-gobbos/maps/ice-island?locationIds=CART_944)
- [Jigsaw Piece](https://mapgenie.io/croc-legend-of-gobbos/maps/desert-island?locationIds=CART_1447) in [Arabian Heights](https://mapgenie.io/croc-legend-of-gobbos/maps/desert-island?locationIds=CART_1405)
- [Jigsaw Piece](https://mapgenie.io/croc-legend-of-gobbos/maps/desert-island?locationIds=CART_1461) in [Defeato Burrito](https://mapgenie.io/croc-legend-of-gobbos/maps/desert-island?locationIds=CART_1460)
- [Jigsaw Piece](https://mapgenie.io/croc-legend-of-gobbos/maps/castle-island?locationIds=CART_1905) in [Smash and See](https://mapgenie.io/croc-legend-of-gobbos/maps/castle-island?locationIds=CART_1900)
- [Jigsaw Piece](https://mapgenie.io/croc-legend-of-gobbos/maps/castle-island?locationIds=CART_1971) in [Jailhouse Croc](https://mapgenie.io/croc-legend-of-gobbos/maps/castle-island?locationIds=CART_1950)

locations.title: Locked Door
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** [Door Key](#loc=1066285)

**Leads to:** [Room 2](#loc=1066414)

locations.title: The Secret Sentinel
locations.description: **Solution:** ||Tailswipe each of the four gongs around the room to damage him. This must be done quickly as he heals every time he attacks. The same gong cannot be used more than once.||

locations.title: Red Button
locations.description: **Location:** Locked in the [Cage](#loc=1066220) at the start of the area after dropping through the well.

locations.title: Red Button
locations.description: **Note:** Pressing this button removes the cork from the [Well](#loc=1066312) at the end of the area.

locations.title: Cage
locations.description:
**Note:** Holds a [Red Button](#loc=1066424).

**Prerequisite:** [Cage Key](#loc=1066215)

locations.title: Cage Key
locations.description:
**Location:** Behind a rock on your right as soon as you start the level.

**Opens:** [Cage](#loc=1066220)

locations.title: Door Key
locations.description:
**Location:** At the bottom of the falling platforms guarded by two dantinis.

**Opens:** [Locked Door](#loc=1066284)

locations.title: Heart
locations.description: **Location:** On top of the platform that appears after pressing the [Red Button](#loc=1066424).

locations.title: Heart
locations.description: **Location:** Inside a red smash box at the top of the cliff.

locations.title: Heart
locations.description: **Location:** Underneath the monkeybars the dantini is standing on. Use the moving floating platform to reach it.

locations.title: Heart
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the second beige smash box after crossing the two sets of rotating platforms.

locations.title: Heart
locations.description: **Location:** On top of the monkeybars. Use the jelly on the opposite side of the monkeybars to reach it.
